svg.title: Shared industrial AI job with two protected resource boundaries
svg.desc: An AI safety reference architecture in which manufacturer and simulation-supplier agents propose work while protected controllers independently check evidence, current authority and safety state before enforcing each resource effect.
svg.metadata: Source: Spherity GmbH. Executive Brief, page 10. CC BY 4.0. Original PDF vector geometry and embedded glyph outlines; crop includes all figure borders and connectors.
